metadata.title: The interaction of core-collapse supernova ejecta with a companion star

notes: No eligible star: the paper models generic 0.9 M☉ G/K-dwarf and 3.5 M☉ late-type B companion stars and discusses SN-induced HVSs only as a population; it does not identify or follow up any individual Galactic unbound candidate (see T:p2-b11 and T:p6-b9).
